package writer_test

// Generator of go-oracle.json: the message of the error the frozen Go writer
// returned for broken result sets (the text the CLI printed on stderr after
// "js-prueffactory: " before it exited with 3). The Go code is frozen, so this
// is kept as text. To regenerate at the freeze commit: copy it to
// internal/writer/zz_oracle_test.go, run
// go test -count=1 -run TestZZOracle ./internal/writer, delete the copy.
// The report folder is written as <DIR>.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset/resultsettest"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/writer"
)

var pointers = regexp.MustCompile(`0x[0-9a-f]+`)

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(s *resultset.Set)
	}{
		{"gates contradict the Findings", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.Gates = 5 }},
		{"made-up budget source", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Run.BudgetSource = "made-up" }},
		{"both", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.Gates = 5; s.Run.BudgetSource = "made-up"; s.Checks[0].Status = "weird" }},
	}
	out := map[string]any{"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8"}
	var list []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases {
		s := resultsettest.Minimal()
		c.mutate(s)
		dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "run")
		err := writer.Write(dir, s, writer.Formats{JSON: true, Markdown: true})
		list = append(list, map[string]any{"name": c.name, "message": pointers.ReplaceAllString(strings.ReplaceAll(err.Error(), dir, "<DIR>"), "<pointer>")})
	}
	out["invalid"] = list
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
